rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon DLL"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/001/"
        tlp = "amber"
        attack_id = "T1071.001"
    strings:
        $x64_beacon_config = { 2E 72 64 61 74 61 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 47 45 54 20 } // ".rdata" followed by "GET "
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" fullword ascii
        $task_sleep = "s" fullword ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $x64_beacon_config at (uint32(uint32(0x3C)) + 0x150) and $user_agent and $task_sleep
}

        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing via dynamic DNS domains"

        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        maltype = "beacon"

        $beacon_get = "GET /news.php?i=" wide ascii

    condition:
        all of them
}
